# Termux-BitNet (v1.0.6)
> ARM64 NEON DotProd SIMD Accelerated 1.58-bit On-Device LLM Inference Engine

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-bitnet
- Installation: `pip install termux-bitnet
# or: npm install -g termux-bitnet`
- Architecture: Executes 1.58-bit ternary quantized weights {-1, 0, +1} directly via hand-vectorized ARM64 NEON assembly kernels, reducing matrix multiplications to integer additions and subtractions with under 350MB RAM footprint.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
from termux_bitnet import BitNetEngine, BitNetConfig

# 1. Initialize engine with model & thread configuration
config = BitNetConfig(
    model_path="models/bitnet-2b.gguf",
    n_threads=4,
    temperature=0.7,
    top_p=0.95
)

# 2. Stream tokens in real time
with BitNetEngine(config) as engine:
    for token in engine.generate_stream("Explain quantum computing in one sentence:"):
        print(token, end="", flush=True)

```
